# robots.txt fixture used by the offline robots tests and by the Step 2 source
# register (source_adapters/README.md). Shape mirrors a real public job board:
# a wildcard group, a named group that is more specific for our agent token, a
# per-path Disallow and a Crawl-delay.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /search
Allow: /search/public
Crawl-delay: 1

User-agent: jobpilot-source-adapters
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /jobs/*/apply
Allow: /jobs/
Allow: /campus-recruitment/
Crawl-delay: 2

User-agent: some-other-bot
Disallow: /
